body:
Not sure why `inherit_handles` was removed, it `execute` is called w/o pipe (only possible from C++ code), it will end up with uninitialized `lpAttributeList` and `bInheritHandles = True`.

It probably should be preserved, passed to `CreateProcessW` and used to set `creation_flags` to `NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS` only if not inheritance needed at all.
